keys.rt_hair_pool_trim: Release inactive snapshots after hold horizon instead of BLAS cache lifetime, retain GPU deferred retirement. No ray count or coverage change; expect less stale pool storage, no promised scene memory percentage. Dialogue3 must have zero pool-full and scene skips. Compact eligible ordinary held snapshots 88 to 24 bytes/vertex (-72.727% payload; 264 to 72 bytes/triangle), preserve native Hair/Tileset/unknown. One 64-thread group/draw, one 2D dispatch, 16 B metadata/draw in retired matrix ring. Copy traffic88-byte read + 88-byte write becomes 24-byte read + 24-byte write per vertex, no ray-count change. Gate positive hold-pack jobs/bytes and zero unavailable builds in every ON window. Judge mesh-cache used MB, not retained pool reservation. Native startup is 88 versus the existing 64-byte Ultra capture (+37.5%); 88/24 is the minimal-layout ratio, not the measured Ultra hair-off ratio.
keys.rt_hair_cheap: One mask sample instead of noise plus two mask samples on physical non-primary candidates: two fewer texture samples per evaluated candidate. Rays unchanged. Energy equivalence unproven. Dedicated hit-AO rays accept the first hit; joint GI/AO radiance rays retain closest search. Same ray count, unmeasured candidate savings. Distance-weighted AO can change when first hit is not nearest: energy gate is mandatory.
keys.rt_hair_gi_mean: Precompute empirical full-material UV/strand-direction mean after alpha commit: 64 UV points x 3 texture reads = 192 texture samples, 512 hard coverage decisions per hair draw per scene; +4 bytes/draw storage. Each GI bounce candidate then uses one stored probability and Bernoulli acceptance, saving 3 texture samples and strand-coverage evaluation; same ray count, physical triangle intersection remains. Approximation can bias energy; not a pass.
keys.rt_hair_visibility: Verified static unpulled Hair VS subset only: full CPU mapped position/index scan plus analytic bounded wind. Reject STORAGE/TRANSFER_DST/XFB source authority; unknown/instanced/Pubes/pulled stays native. Keep near bounds inside max(gi_rt_radius, enabled gi_far_m), or projected width OR height >1 render pixel including FP32 envelope. Only distant subpixel hair draws keep ordinary cards: zero native records/procedural primitives and native coverage samples for those draws, ordinary card traversal remains. This is per-draw, not whole-character bounds. No positive savings predicted without eligible/cards counters; all unknown is a null result, not a pass.
